output.one_liner: Biome is a high-performance toolchain for web projects that formats, lints, and analyzes code instantly for JavaScript and TypeScript developers.
output.description: Biome is a modern toolchain for web development that combines formatting, linting, and static analysis in one fast, zero-configuration tool. Built in Rust, it's designed to be a drop-in replacement for tools like ESLint and Prettier. It supports JavaScript, TypeScript, JSX, and more with deep editor integration and minimal setup.

icp.who: Web developers working on JavaScript or TypeScript projects
icp.pain: Slow toolchains, complex configuration, and fragmented workflows using multiple tools like ESLint, Prettier, and Babel
icp.buying_trigger: Starting a new project or seeking to improve build performance and developer experience in an existing codebase

differentiators: All-in-one toolchain combining formatting, linting, and analysis
Extremely fast performance due to Rust implementation
Drop-in replacement for ESLint and Prettier
proof_points: Over 500 lint rules available (found on homepage)
